data.job_title: AI Engineer Machine Learning Systems, Model Deployment & AI Pipelines
data.additional_information:
AI Engineer
Machine Learning Systems, Model Deployment & AI Pipelines
Location: Hyderabad / Remote-Capable Type: Permanent · Full-Time
Compensation: FP1 to FP3 · ₹16 LPA to ₹45 LPA
CTC
Contact: Placement Cell
THE ROLE
Fluxion's AI engineering function is the most technically demanding layer of our stack. We are working on physics-informed
neural networks for industrial process prediction, graph neural networks for multi-modal logistics optimisation, computer vision
systems for autonomous port cargo handling, and clinical NLP for hospital operations.
We engage international research partners from Berkeley and specialist robotics institutes. The AI engineer we hire from campus
will be the internal technical function that works alongside these partners, builds production implementations of their research
outputs, and takes responsibility for what runs in live deployments.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Implementation and adaptation of physics-informed ML models for industrial process prediction: sinter bed combustion, blast
furnace thermal state, and rolling mill pass optimisation
– Graph neural network work for supply chain and logistics: modelling multi-node cargo flows as structured graph problems
– Computer vision pipeline development for port automation: object detection, container tracking, autonomous vehicle perception,
and OCR for container identification
– Clinical AI development for ETOH: NLP for patient record processing and outcome prediction models
– Model productionisation: converting research-grade implementations into efficient, monitorable inference systems for edge or
on-premise deployment
– Technical engagement with external research partners: understanding their deliverables, reviewing implementations, and identifying
what needs to change for production
– MLOps infrastructure: experiment tracking, model versioning, performance monitoring, and retraining pipelines
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in computer science, mathematics, or engineering with strong ML fundamentals from a recognised
institution
– Genuine depth in at least one ML area beyond standard supervised learning: you have gone past tutorials and built something
non-trivial
– Any prior project or research experience involving physics-informed ML, graph networks, computer vision, or NLP at a non-trivial
level
– Understanding that industrial AI is different from consumer AI: latency, interpretability, safety, and the cost of silent failure in a
physical system
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.
